Large fully furnished house by the sea with its own beach line. Access to wood-fired sauna for an additional fee of NOK 300 (1 bag of wood) and jacuzzi for an additional fee of NOK 300 per day. 4 large bedrooms with double beds, space for 8 people. Possibility of baby bed on request. 15 min by car to Tromsø city center. Close to alpine facilities, ski slopes and shop. Fantastic outdoor area with midnight sun in summer and northern lights in winter. Space for several cars in the driveway. Good internet. Can accommodate 3 more people

Johannes
Zürich, Switzerland
Rating, 5 stars
,
·
March 2026
,
·
Group trip
We had a fantastic week with our larger family (10 adults) at Heidi’s place! Every room has a gorgeous view over the sea. The house feels warm and cozy. It is functionally equipped with everything you need. 
We had several nights of aurora displays visible from the porch, or even better: from the jacuzzi. What a wonderful experience! 
Same goes for the wood-fired sauna. It took a bit of getting the hang of heating it up properly but then it was awesome. The small private beach invited for a dip into the ice cold sea afterwards for those daring to :) 
On top of everything, Heidi was responding incredibly fast to any questions or issues coming up. There was some issue with the WiFi and Heidi tried to have it fixed even in the evening. Ultimately, she had the router replaced, solving the issue for us. 
Heidi, thank you for this amazing stay in your beautiful house! If we may, we’ll come back again sooner rather than later! 
„Der var så bra. Tusen takk!“ :)

The house is beautifully located by the sea, with beautiful views from the terrace. The apartment is spacious, but the lower level sometimes seems only "half-finished." The bathroom with the shower is nicely new and very spacious. Unfortunately, we found the kitchen very dirty. There was also only a dirty dishwashing brush, etc., and the kitchen looked very dirty overall (oven, stove tops). The same goes for the washing machine for clothes, which we didn't want to use in that condition. During our stay, the dishwasher was broken, but that's not Heidi's fault. Except for the kitchen and the washing machine, the cleanliness was OK. Although the rooms can be partially darkened, they are still very bright in good weather and with the current position of the sun.

The place was very nice and perfect for our group of 8 people.
If there are more people, please note that there is a double bed in a separate building that is not connected to the main house.
The sauna is a bit old, but it worked perfectly. Unfortunately, the hot tub stopped working after a few days and had a bit of an odor. However, Heidi's husband was always on site quickly in case of any problems.
